name: Pentagon 50EC Insecticide
uses: thrips and aphids on vegetables, flowers and field crops
settings: Agricultural: vegetable, flower and field crop growers
lead: Pentagon 50EC, known as Kiua Dudu, is a lambda-cyhalothrin insecticide from Greenlife Crop Protection Africa for control of thrips and aphids on crops. Thrips and aphids suck sap, curl and scar leaves and spread plant viruses, so a fast-acting, affordable insecticide protects yield.
method: Mix with water to form a milky spray liquid, as the label directs. Avoid spraying in strong wind and take care that spray does not drift to ponds, rivers or neighbouring crops.
extraSteps: Scout your crop regularly and spray when pests reach damaging levels.
Rotate with products that have a different mode of action, and do not spray when bees are actively foraging.

name: Ranger 480EC Insecticide
uses: aphids and thrips in roses and antestia bugs in coffee
targets: Aphids, thrips and whiteflies in roses; thrips and antestia bugs in coffee; termites in building and construction
settings: Agricultural and construction: flower farms, coffee growers and contractors
lead: Greenlife Ranger 480EC is a chlorpyrifos insecticide for control of aphids, thrips and whiteflies in roses, thrips and antestia bugs in coffee, and termites in building and construction. It serves flower farms, coffee growers and contractors.
method: Mix as the label directs for your crop, rate and timing, and spray in calm conditions. Do not spray when strong wind could carry the spray away.
extraSteps: Scout crops often and spray only when pests reach damaging levels; rotate with insecticides that have different modes of action to slow resistance.
Do not spray near ponds, rivers or boreholes, and avoid spraying when bees are active.
labelNeeded: dose per litre / per knapsack for each use

name: Systema 50EC Insecticide
uses: crop pests on vegetables, flowers and field crops
targets: Crop pests (pests and approved crops to be confirmed on the label)
settings: Agricultural: vegetable, flower and field crop growers
lead: Farmbridge Systema 50EC is an emulsifiable concentrate insecticide for crop pest control. The 1 litre pack gives vegetable, flower and field crop growers a convenient liquid insecticide for their spray programme.
method: Measure the product and mix it with water in a knapsack sprayer or tank, as the label directs, then spray early morning or late afternoon, away from strong wind.
extraSteps: Scout fields often, check the underside of leaves and young shoots, and spray when pests reach damaging levels.
Rotate insecticides with different modes of action, keep weeds down, remove crop residues, and do not spray when bees are foraging.

name: Thunder OD 145 Foliar Insecticide
uses: thrips, aphids and whiteflies on tomatoes
targets: Thrips, aphids and whiteflies on tomatoes, French beans and other crops
settings: Agricultural: tomato, French bean and other crop growers
lead: Bayer Thunder OD 145 combines imidacloprid and beta-cyfluthrin in an oil dispersion foliar insecticide for thrips, aphids and whiteflies on tomatoes, French beans and other crops. Two modes of action (IRAC Groups 3A and 4A) give broader control and support resistance management.
method: Mix as the label directs and use enough water for good coverage. Spray both sides of the leaves, where whiteflies and aphids hide.
extraSteps: Scout fields weekly and spray when pest numbers reach damaging levels; follow the label on the number of sprays.
Rotate with insecticides from other groups, avoid spraying while bees are active, and do not spray near ponds, rivers or boreholes.

name: Tihan Insecticide
uses: sucking and chewing insects on crops
targets: Sucking and chewing insects on various crops (pests and crops to be confirmed on the label)
lead: Tihan is a broad-spectrum insecticide for pest control. It is effective against sucking and chewing insects on various crops and supports healthy plant growth.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs, shaking the container well and agitating the tank while you spray. Never mix with other products unless the label allows it.

name: Easygro Calcium Water Soluble Fertilizer 14:0:2+TE
targets: Calcium and magnesium needs of crops; helps prevent blossom end rot in tomatoes and tip burn in leafy vegetables
settings: Agricultural: foliar feeding and fertigation on commercial and smallholder farms
lead: Easygro Calcium is a water-soluble fertilizer with 15% calcium, 2.5% magnesium and trace elements for foliar feeding and fertigation. Calcium builds strong cell walls to improve fruit firmness, reduce blossom end rot in tomatoes and tip burn in leafy vegetables, and extend shelf life; magnesium supports chlorophyll and plant vigor.
method: Apply as a foliar feed or through fertigation, with uniform coverage and following recommended practice for your crop and soil.
extraSteps: Use it on crops with high calcium and magnesium demand during critical vegetative and reproductive growth stages.
Read and follow all label instructions and local recommendations before application.
labelNeeded: application rate for foliar feeding and fertigation

name: Easygro Fruit & Flower
uses: fruit and flower nutrition in gardens
targets: Nutrition for fruiting and flowering plants (nutrient analysis to be confirmed on the label)
lead: Easygro Fruit & Flower is a nutrient-rich fertilizer for fruits and flowers. It promotes vibrant blooms and healthy growth in home gardens and on farms.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs, using the rate and timing for your crop.

name: Optimizer
uses: nutrient uptake and plant growth in crops
targets: Plant growth regulation and nutrient uptake (composition to be confirmed on the label)
settings: Agricultural: a range of crops (crops to be confirmed on the label)
lead: Optimizer is a plant growth regulator and nutrient optimizer that helps plants take up nutrients and grow well. It is aimed at growers who want to support yield and quality in their crops.
method: Mix and apply exactly as the manufacturer's label directs, using the rate and timing for your crop.

name: Rootex 6 Rooting Hormone
uses: rooting of cuttings of roses, carnations and ornamentals
targets: Rooting of cuttings: roses, carnations and other ornamentals
settings: Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners
lead: Rootex 6 is a rooting hormone powder that helps cuttings of roses, carnations and other ornamentals form strong, healthy roots. Nurseries, flower farms and home gardeners use it for faster, more even rooting and a higher success rate.
dose: Used as a powder dip: no mixing with water is needed. Pour a small amount into a separate container for dipping, not into the main tub, to avoid contaminating the rest.
method: Take a healthy cutting with a clean, sharp knife or secateurs. Dip the cut end into the powder, tap off any extra and plant it straight away into a clean, well-drained rooting medium.
extraSteps: Water lightly and keep the cuttings in a warm, shaded and humid place until roots form.
Use clean tools and trays, choose healthy cuttings, keep the medium moist but not waterlogged and protect cuttings from direct hot sun until they have rooted.
labelNeeded: time to rooting for each crop
